WithTop wait and Sum stopped tag; finite untopD branch guarded by not-top; clipped raw clocks distinguished from source support.
Canonical infinite product of unit exponentials; old law supplies probability and all-coordinate positivity internally.

Existing harmonic/hazard/actual-history and recursion measurability composed without assuming bounce continuity.
Strict subtype and comap volume match prefix parent; empty prefix is included.
Ordered-prefix density/test law used with terminally weighted history test and endpoint observer; parent proof not rereviewed.
History-dependent residual duration supplied measurably to existing conditional survival set-law; no positive event mass.

Multiply q by terminal W and use F(h,Psi(h)); yields unnormalized joint interpolation law and finite mass.
Existing nonexplosion lineage consumed through physical-time cover, no reproof or extra public bound.
ActualPhysicalTimeCover supplies almost-sure all-time interval existence and residual survival, used only at fixed T here.
One existing jointly Borel actual representative has raw covered/fallback behavior and AE initialization; chosen internally.
Product hyperplane nullity passes through comap and arbitrary nonnegative withDensity; no density boundedness is needed.
Strict-prefix law at T+1 and hyperplane nullity; positivity supplies strict guard. This uniform route handles T=0 too, refining graph note that listed a separate zero case.
Countable Borel interval predicates, measurable least index and zero outside union; raw totalization only.
Raw C subset I, AE converse via positive clocks/noatoms/cover, disjointness and cardinalities; fixed T is outside AE.
Finite prescribed history followed by increasing-index fold; at equality the post-jump state is selected.
All functions on finite closed horizon with coordinate product measurable space; no topological path-space equivalence.
Coordinate fold and composition give Psi/Gamma measurability; joint Z separately gives every coordinate of ZT.
On each raw C sample, finite greatest eligible index selects a genuinely covering interval at every s<=T; funext, not uncountable AE intersections.

n=0 uses actual initial time zero in raw C subset I; all n,T quantified including zero. Empty-simplex mass and zero horizon semantics are consequences of literals/parent conventions, not normalization for T>0.
Assemble one Z; replace count restriction by C a.e.; pointwise path equality on C transports joint map/all measurable ENNReal tests; exact component mass.

No identification of every rate with printed left-limit path rate proved here.

No cadlag regularity or Skorokhod Borel compatibility claimed.

exposition_regions.formula: \Psi_n(h)(s)=\Phi_{s-a_j}(z_j),\quad j=\max\{i\le n:h_i=\operatorname{live}(a_i,z_i),\ a_i\le s\},\quad\text{if this set is nonempty; otherwise }\Psi_n(h)(s)=z_0.
exposition_regions.exposition: Fix one coordinate s of the path. Each tagged record either retains the accumulator or replaces it by the harmonic flow at s−a; the live/stopped tag and a≤s are Borel. Finite induction proves the fold measurable. The product sigma algebra then makes the entire function-valued map measurable by its coordinates. The last eligible record controls the fold, including when no record is eligible and z₀ remains. Reuse the actual harmonic-flow joint measurability to obtain Ψ for every parameter and arbitrary history.

exposition_regions.exposition: The actual conditional survival theorem applies at the history-dependent residual d=max(T−lastTime,0). exposition_regions.title: Make the total count measurable and relate interval indices to cardinalities

exposition_regions.title: Close count interpretation, disjointness and full probability
exposition_regions.formula: N(T)=n\ \Longleftrightarrow\ C_n(T)\quad P\text{-a.s.},\qquad N(T)=\#\{j>0:T_j<T\}=\#\{j>0:T_j\le T\}.\qquad C_i\cap C_j=\varnothing\ (i\ne j),\quad P(\bigcup_n C_n)=1.
exposition_regions.exposition: On every raw C_n, the last time is at most T (initial time0 handles n=0), and survival makes the next time strictly greater than T: thus C_n⊆I_n. Conversely, on the common full event of positive clocks, fixed-T no-atoms and physical-time coverage, any covering interval has a live history with strictly increasing times and all positive-index times below T, and its residual wait survives to T. Hence I_n=C_n on that event for all n. The least covering index is unique, so N=n iff C_n and the preceding cardinality lemma applies. Raw C disjointness follows from C_n⊆I_n and monotonicity. Almost-sure coverage then makes their countable union have mass1.
